# app
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package app is MUSA as a whole: the theme, the places a person moves between (home, the stand, catalogue, fairs, orders) and the frame around them, a bar along the bottom. Each place's screens live in its own package.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `const Accent = "#3F4A5A"` | Accent is MUSA's colour: a deep slate, quiet like ink, so the artwork brings the colour. |
| `type App struct{ ... }` | App is everything MUSA remembers between frames. |
| `func New(database *storage.Database, options Options) (*App, error)` | New opens MUSA over an open database. |
| `type Options struct{ ... }` | Options are how the program was started. |
| `type Place int` | Place is one of the parts of MUSA the index leads to. |
| `const Home Place = iota ...` | The places, in the index's order. |
